embeds.title: MEMBER ROLES
embeds.description:
Choose your path.

<:ironsworn:1558623401302564996> <@&1558540424048803860> — You play an ironman. Full member. Ranks, bingos, and WOM competitions are yours to conquer.

<:unbound:1558623453438025828> <@&1558540434652008569> — You play a main; you can hang out, earn seniority, and join casual events.

<:guest:1558634092185002035> <@&1558540445611728997> — You're just visiting or here for a friend.

<:clanfriend:1558634136510537728> <@&1558621489283211316> — Trusted friends, hand-picked by staff.

embeds.title: Staff Roles
embeds.description:
Those who lead the chaos.

⛧ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⛧

<:lordofchaos:1558876846618312795> <@&1558578603359207555>
• They oversee the entire clan and make all final decisions regarding leadership, direction, and major changes.

<:warmonger:1558876917803778139> <@&1558578608233119765>
• They support the Lord of Chaos by helping guide decisions, overseeing inquisitors and ritualists, and keeping daily operations running smoothly.

<:ritualist:1558876987534221503> <@&1558578610988916736>
• They design and run the events you see in Oath Forsaken, maintaining the calendar and keeping activities fun, organized, and engaging.

<:inquisitor:1558877058346520728> <@&1558578613404696596>
• They monitor in-game and Discord chats, handle reports and issues, manage ranks, and ensure a positive environment for all Oath Forsaken members.

<:chaosmachinist:1558956048713252984> <@&1558947396065431572>
• They keep the Discord running. Bots, integrations, channels, permissions. If it's technical, it's theirs.
